title: Truth sounds like hate to those who are in love with a lie. 🗣️🚫
paragraphs: Truth sounds like hate to those who are in love with a lie. 🗣️🚫
This is the hardest reality check for anyone fighting the good fight. You try to bring light into a situation, and instead of gratitude, you get anger. Why?
Because the truth is disruptive. It demands change. It shines a spotlight on things people desperately want to keep hidden in the dark.
Lies act like a spiritual anesthetic—they numb the pain and keep people comfortable in their dysfunction. The truth is like surgery—it hurts before it heals.
Most people would rather stay comfortably sick than endure the temporary pain of getting well.
But listen to me, warrior: Don't water down the medicine just because the patient hates the taste. We aren't called to make people comfortable; we are called to set them FREE. Keep speaking it.
📖 The diagnosis from Scripture: "This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil." — John 3:19 (NIV)
Are you willing to be unpopular for the sake of the Gospel? Drop a 🔥 if you’re battling for the truth today!
